**Styregruppen** (The Steering Committee) is the central decision-making and overarching quality management authority for the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] in Denmark [^src1], [^src6]. It is responsible for assessing the clinical relevance of quality indicators, maintaining national standards for ADHD assessment and treatment, and auditing the database's annual reports [^src1], [^src6]. The committee plays a critical role in shaping diagnostic and therapeutic practices within Danish child, youth, and adult psychiatry by evaluating systemic challenges, regional inequalities, and resource constraints [^src7], [^src12].

A primary focus of Styregruppen is ensuring that clinical practices align with national guidelines, such as the [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG-retningslinje]] established by the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)]]. For instance, the committee has formally assessed that somatic examinations are an essential component of ADHD assessments to rule out differential diagnoses and identify comorbid somatic conditions [^src1], [^src8]. 

Between 2023 and 2024, Styregruppen initiated several strategic revisions to the database's quality indicators to better reflect clinical realities and operational feasibility. The committee decided to modify [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] to eventually include structured information from schools or institutions, while also introducing a [[new-indicator-for-systematic-symptom-assessment|new-indicator-for-systematic-symptom-assessment]] for broad psychopathological screening for children and adolescents [^src2], [^src9]. Furthermore, the committee has heavily scrutinized [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], which mandates diagnostic conferences. While there is strong agreement on the [[diagnostic-conference-importance|diagnostic-conference-importance]] as the cornerstone of a thorough assessment, Styregruppen has navigated disagreements regarding the [[professional-qualification-for-conference|professional-qualification-for-conference]], particularly amid legislative changes allowing a [[specialpsykolog]] to diagnose alongside [[speciallaeger|speciallæger]] [^src3], [^src7], [^src10].

The committee has also driven reforms in treatment and cross-sectoral collaboration indicators. It oversaw the revision of [[indikator-4|Indikator 4]] (coordinating network meetings) to make it more operationally realistic for cross-sectoral cooperation [^src4], [^src10]. Regarding treatment, Styregruppen maintains that non-pharmacological interventions, such as psychoeducation ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]), remain vital for treatment quality and cannot be entirely replaced by digital or app-based solutions [^src4], [^src11]. It also governs standards for pharmacological treatment ([[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]) and has actively discussed the implementation and target populations for newer metrics like psychotherapy for adults ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]), social support assessments ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]), and adult pharmacological treatment ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src5], [^src11], [^src12], [^src13], [^src14]. Additionally, the committee continuously evaluates the composition of the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]], including whether certain pediatric pathways should be excluded from adult population metrics [^src12].

## Claims

**quality-standard**
- Standarden for indikator 2a er ≥ 90 % [^src1]

**governance**
- Indikator 3 er et fokuspunkt for styregruppen i det kommende år pga. stigende patientantal, manglende speciallæger og lovgivningsændringer, der tillader specialpsykologer at stille diagnoser [^src1]
- Styregruppen vil ved næste styregruppemøde tage endelig stilling til om Indikator 11 i stedet skal indgå som supplerende materiale[^src1].

**policy**
- Styregruppen vurderer fortsat at nonfarmakologiske behandlingstiltag er vigtige for kvaliteten af behandlingen af ADHD [^src1]
- Styregruppen vil anvende DMPG-retningslinjen for non-farmakologisk behandling af ADHD i sit videre arbejde med Indikator 5 [^src1]
